query:
UPDATE entries e
            SET title = COALESCE($3, e.title),
                content = COALESCE($4, e.content),
                entry_date = COALESCE($5, e.entry_date)
            FROM notebooks s, journals w
            WHERE e.id = $1
                AND e.notebook_id = s.id
                AND s.journal_id = w.id
                AND w.user_id = $2
